native: as a powerful reminder of a dark period in history and the triumph of the human spirit.

en: The event fundamentally reshaped Europe in the world, proving that even the most formidable
zh: 這一事件從根本上重塑了歐洲和世界，證明即使是最強大的
ja: この出来事はヨーロッパと世界を根本的に変え、最も強力な
local: The event fundamentally reshaped Europe in the world, proving that even the most formidable
native: The event fundamentally reshaped Europe in the world, proving that even the most formidable

en: symbols of division can eventually fall. It was a victory for freedom, democracy, and the human
zh: 分裂象徵最終也會倒下。這是自由、民主和人類
ja: 分断の象徴でさえ最終的には崩れることを証明した。これは自由、民主主義、人間の
local: symbols of division can eventually fall. It was a victory for freedom, democracy, and the human
native: symbols of division can eventually fall. It was a victory for freedom, democracy, and the human

en: spirit, a moment etched forever in the annals of history. That was an amazing story.
zh: 精神的勝利，一個永遠銘刻在歷史記錄中的時刻。那真是一個驚人的故事。
ja: 精神の勝利であり、歴史の記録に永遠に刻まれる瞬間だった。それは素晴らしい物語だった。
local: spirit, a moment etched forever in the annals of history. That was an amazing story.
native: spirit, a moment etched forever in the annals of history. That was an amazing story.

en: Yes, the fall of the Berlin Wall is truly inspiring. I can't imagine living with a wall like that.
zh: 是的，柏林牆的倒塌確實令人鼓舞。我無法想像生活在那樣的牆壁旁。
ja: はい、ベルリンの壁の崩壊は本当に感動的です。あんな壁と共に暮らすことは想像できません。
local: Yes, the fall of the Berlin Wall is truly inspiring. I can't imagine living with a wall like that.
native: Yes, the fall of the Berlin Wall is truly inspiring. I can't imagine living with a wall like that.

en: It must have been very difficult. So it really fell because of a mistake?
zh: 那一定非常困難。那麼它真的因為一個錯誤而倒塌嗎？
ja: それはとても大変だったに違いない。つまり、本当にミスが原因で崩壊したのですか？
local: It must have been very difficult. So it really fell because of a mistake?
native: It must have been very difficult. So it really fell because of a mistake?

en: Yes, a misunderstanding at a press conference. That's incredible, a small error changed history.
zh: 是的，新聞發布會上的誤解。真不可思議，一個小錯誤改變了歷史。
ja: はい、記者会見での誤解です。それは信じられない、小さなミスが歴史を変えたのです。
local: Yes, a misunderstanding at a press conference. That's incredible, a small error changed history.
native: Yes, a misunderstanding at a press conference. That's incredible, a small error changed history.

en: It was the spark, but the pressure was building. The Monday demonstrations were very important.
zh: 那是火花，但壓力正在累積。週一示威非常重要。
ja: それがきっかけだったが、圧力は高まっていた。月曜デモは非常に重要だった。
local: It was the spark, but the pressure was building. The Monday demonstrations were very important.
native: It was the spark, but the pressure was building. The Monday demonstrations were very important.

en: People wanted freedom and change. And Hungary, opening its border, helped a lot.
zh: 人們渴望自由和變革。匈牙利開放邊界幫了大忙。
ja: 人々は自由と変化を求めていた。そしてハンガリーが国境を開放したことが大いに役立った。
local: People wanted freedom and change. And Hungary, opening its border, helped a lot.
native: People wanted freedom and change. And Hungary, opening its border, helped a lot.

en: It allowed many East Germans to leave. The Stasi must have been a scary presence.
zh: 這讓許多東德人得以離開。史塔西一定是個可怕的存在。
ja: 多くの東ドイツ人が出国できるようになった。シュタージは恐ろしい存在だったに違いない。
local: It allowed many East Germans to leave. The Stasi must have been a scary presence.
native: It allowed many East Germans to leave. The Stasi must have been a scary presence.

en: Yes, the secret police watched everyone. I didn't know about Glosnost and Parastroika.
zh: 是的，秘密警察監視著每個人。我不知道關於公開性和改革開放。
ja: はい、秘密警察は全員を監視していた。グラスノスチとペレストロイカについては知らなかった。
local: Yes, the secret police watched everyone. I didn't know about Glosnost and Parastroika.
native: Yes, the secret police watched everyone. I didn't know about Glosnost and Parastroika.

en: Gorbachev's reforms helped loosen control.
zh: 戈爾巴喬夫的改革幫助放鬆了控制。
ja: ゴルバチョフの改革が統制を緩めるのに役立った。
local: Gorbachev's reforms helped loosen control.
native: Gorbachev's reforms helped loosen control.

en: It's good that it was mostly peaceful. It was a triumph for peaceful protest.
zh: 大多數是和平的真是太好了。這是和平抗議的勝利。
ja: ほとんどが平和的だったのは良かった。これは平和的抗議の勝利だった。
local: It's good that it was mostly peaceful. It was a triumph for peaceful protest.
native: It's good that it was mostly peaceful. It was a triumph for peaceful protest.

en: Germany reunified quickly after the Wall fell. Less than a year later in 1990.
zh: 柏林牆倒塌後，德國迅速統一。不到一年後的1990年。
ja: 壁が崩壊した後、ドイツは迅速に再統一された。1990年の1年も経たないうちに。
local: Germany reunified quickly after the Wall fell. Less than a year later in 1990.
native: Germany reunified quickly after the Wall fell. Less than a year later in 1990.

en: What a powerful symbol of hope. It truly was. Keep learning level casters.
zh: 多麼強大的希望象徵。確實如此。繼續學習，等級播報員們。
ja: なんて力強い希望の象徴だろう。本当にそうだ。レベルキャスターの皆さん、学び続けてください。
local: What a powerful symbol of hope. It truly was. Keep learning level casters.
native: What a powerful symbol of hope. It truly was. Keep learning level casters.

en: That's all for today. Keep it up, and we'll see you in the next level cast lesson.
zh: 今天就到這裡。繼續努力，我們下次等級播報課程見。
ja: 今日はこれで終わりです。頑張って、次のレベルキャストのレッスンでお会いしましょう。
local: That's all for today. Keep it up, and we'll see you in the next level cast lesson.
native: That's all for today. Keep it up, and we'll see you in the next level cast lesson.
